members.name: var0
members.instructions: A customer of a digital bank sent this message to the support chat. Which specific issue is the customer asking about? Pick the closest match.

criteria.age_limit: minimum age to open an account or use the service
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: using or setting up Apple Pay or Google Pay
criteria.atm_support: where ATMs can be used, which ATMs accept the card
criteria.automatic_top_up: setting up or how auto top-up works
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: balance not updated after a bank transfer into the account
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: a cheque or cash deposit not showing in the balance
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: cannot add a beneficiary/payee or beneficiary not allowed
criteria.cancel_transfer: cancelling or reversing a transfer the customer made
criteria.card_about_to_expire: card expiring soon, renewing an expiring card
criteria.card_acceptance: where the card is accepted by merchants
criteria.card_arrival: ordered card has not arrived yet, tracking the card delivery
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: how long card delivery takes, delivery options
criteria.card_linking: linking an existing card to the app / adding a card to the account
criteria.card_not_working: physical card not working at all
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: a fee charged on card payments; why card payments have fees
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: a card payment the customer does not recognise / didn't make
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: wrong exchange rate applied to a card payment abroad
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: fee charged for an ATM cash withdrawal
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: a cash withdrawal the customer did not make
criteria.change_pin: changing the card PIN to a new one (how/where to change it)
criteria.compromised_card: card details possibly compromised or stolen by someone, suspicious use
criteria.country_support: which countries the service is available in / supported countries for residence
criteria.declined_card_payment: a card payment was declined or refused when trying to pay
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: an ATM cash withdrawal was declined
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: a direct debit the customer does not recognise
criteria.disposable_card_limits: limits on how many times a disposable virtual card can be used
criteria.edit_personal_details: changing name, address or other personal details
criteria.exchange_rate: what exchange rate is used / where rates come from
criteria.exchange_via_app: how to exchange currencies in the app
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: an extra charge on the statement, e.g. a small or pending charge (like £1) the customer did not expect
criteria.fiat_currency_support: which currencies can be held or exchanged
criteria.get_physical_card: getting a physical card, or questions about the card's PIN (where to find it, what it is, getting a PIN)
criteria.passcode_forgotten: forgot the app passcode / can't log in with passcode
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: ATM cash withdrawal still showing as pending
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked after too many wrong attempts
criteria.receiving_money: how to receive money into the account, e.g. getting paid or receiving a salary
criteria.refund_not_showing_up: a refund from a merchant hasn't appeared
criteria.request_refund: requesting a refund for a purchase
criteria.reverted_card_payment: a card payment was reverted, cancelled or came back / returned to the account after being made (e.g. 'the payment suddenly came back')
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: which cards, card types and currencies can be used to top up (e.g. what type of card can I top up with)
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: fee for topping up by bank transfer
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: fee for topping up by card
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: topping up with cash or a cheque
criteria.topping_up_by_card: the process of topping up using a card, top-up by card not showing
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: the same transaction charged twice / duplicate charge
criteria.transfer_into_account: how to transfer money into the account
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: recipient did not receive a transfer
criteria.transfer_timing: how long transfers take to arrive
criteria.verify_my_identity: how to verify identity, documents needed
criteria.verify_top_up: verifying a top-up / card verification code for top-up
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Visa or Mastercard: whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, choosing one, or whether a Visa or Mastercard can be used
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: ATM gave the wrong amount of cash
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: wrong exchange rate on a cash withdrawal abroad
